scenes.say: Why does a baby have more bones than you?
A newborn has around three hundred bones.
You have two hundred and six. So where did the rest go?
They didn't disappear. They fused together as you grew, like the plates of your skull.
And look where most of them ended up. More than half are in your hands and feet.
And every one is alive inside, built in layers.
Which is exactly why a baby has more bones than you.
